# Zuchen Li (李祖臣)

> Undergraduate at the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, majoring in Statistics & Computer Science with a minor in History. Aiming for a PhD in HCI / AI. Previously studied Statistics & Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (minor in Meteorology).

Personal homepage: https://lzclink.com/

## Research interests

- Human–AI Interaction: real-time human–GenAI co-creation, gesture-driven interfaces, GUI-agent robustness
- Context-Aware Intelligent Systems: contextualized live visual instruction bridging generative foundation models and real-world task execution
- Ubiquitous Sensing: camera-based Moiré-encoded sensing, multimodal respiratory sensing, visual-privacy defenses against VLM inference
- AI4Science: statistical ML for aerosol–cloud interactions, dimension reduction for clinical wearable data

## Research experience

- HAIL Lab, University of Michigan — Research Assistant, advised by Prof. Anhong Guo (May 2026 – present): contextualized live visual instruction; mixed-reality systems that reason over live workspaces and generate spatially situated guidance.
- Ambient Intelligence Lab, University of Michigan — Research Assistant, advised by Prof. Ke Sun (Oct 2025 – present): agentic visual-privacy framework against VLM inference; camera-based Moiré fabrication sensing; RespiraFrame eyeglass-based respiratory sensing (with Prof. Junyi Zhu).
- Generative AI for Music and Audio, University of Michigan — Research Assistant, advised by Prof. Herman Dong (Sept 2025 – present): real-time human–GenAI co-creation for controllable music generation; gesture-driven interaction techniques.
- Energy Distance Dimension Reduction, University of Michigan — URPS Selected Researcher, advised by Prof. Kerby Shedden (Jan – May 2025): engression and sufficient dimension reduction for multilevel wearable data; JAX GPU re-implementation with ~7,000× speedup.
- Lab of Atmospheric and Earth System Sciences, Nanjing University — Summer Research Intern, advised by Prof. Minghuai Wang (May – Aug 2024): statistical ML for aerosol–cloud interactions.
- E2-E Lab, UIUC — Undergraduate Research Assistant (Aug 2023 – May 2024): airflow experiments, PIV processing (OpenCV/OpenPIV), CFD simulation (ANSYS Fluent).

## Selected projects

- MagicBaton: gesture-based human–AI music interaction — dual-IMU smart conducting baton, real-time edge gesture recognition, jerk-based beat/BPM estimation, MIDI + Magenta MusicRNN; public dataset of ~934 recordings across 8 gesture classes. https://lzclink.com/projects/magicbaton/
- Multimodal FSM for Adaptive Skill Guidance: VLM + YAMNet audio fused with a 12-state machine for real-time hand-washing guidance; Qwen3-VL and Gemini backends. https://lzclink.com/projects/adaptive-skill-guidance/
- How Fragile Are GUI Agents?: controlled perturbation benchmark across five interface-evolution categories, built on VisualWebArena. https://lzclink.com/projects/gui-agent-fragility/
- Bayesian MCMC for Ebola outbreak data: data-augmentation MCMC for partially observed, censored epidemic records. https://lzclink.com/projects/ebola-mcmc/
